text: Given a valid X-Dnsfilter-Api-Key header, when dnsfilter_list_organizations is called, then it returns the organizations visible to that key (id, name, type), paginated
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_list_organizations_returns_visible_orgs_paginated -> 1 passed; respx-mocked GET /v1/organizations, asserts items==[{id:1,name,type:'msp'},{id:2,...,type:'normal'}] and has_more=false

text: Given a valid API key and an organization id, when dnsfilter_get_organization is called, then it returns that organization's basic information
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_get_organization_returns_basic_info -> 1 passed; respx-mocked GET /v1/organizations/2, asserts full body equality

text: Given a valid API key, when dnsfilter_list_networks is called, then it returns networks with organization_id and policy_id populated, and no secret_key field anywhere in the response
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k 'test_list_networks_populates_ids_and_strips_secret_key or test_list_networks_filters_by_organization_id_client_side or test_get_network_strips_secret_key' -> 3 passed; asserts raw response text never contains 'secret_key' or the mocked secret value

text: Given a valid API key and a policy id, when dnsfilter_get_policy is called, then it returns the full policy configuration (allow/block lists, blocked categories, safe-search flags, YouTube restriction, allow-list-only)
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_get_policy_returns_full_configuration -> 1 passed; asserts whitelist_domains, blacklist_domains, blacklist_categories, allow_list_only, google_safesearch, youtube_restricted, youtube_restricted_level, network_ids

text: Given a valid API key and an organization id, when dnsfilter_list_policies is called, then it returns the policies defined for that organization
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_list_policies_scoped_to_organization -> 1 passed; asserts the organization_id query param sent to DNSFilter and the returned items

text: Given a valid API key, when dnsfilter_list_categories is called, then it returns the content category taxonomy with the security flag per category
Given a valid API key and a time range, when dnsfilter_get_traffic_summary is called with metric=requests and again with metric=threats, then both return a bucketed count series for the window
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_get_traffic_summary_both_metrics -> 1 passed; both /v1/traffic_reports/total_requests and total_threats mocked, asserts buckets+total for each

text: Given a valid API key and a time range, when dnsfilter_get_top_report is called with each of dimension=categories|domains|networks|organizations, then it returns a ranked top-N list for that dimension
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_get_top_report_all_dimensions -> 1 passed; all 4 dimensions mocked and asserted, including that dimension=organizations never sends security_report (vendor endpoint has no such filter)

text: Given the X-Dnsfilter-Api-Key header is missing, when any tool is called, then it returns a structured unauthorized error and makes zero outbound calls to DNSFilter
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k 'test_no_credentials_returns_not_configured_without_calling_api or test_missing_header_returns_401_with_required_headers_listed' -> 2 passed; tool-level test uses a respx router with no mocked routes and an AssertionError side_effect to prove zero outbound calls; middleware test asserts HTTP 401 + required_headers list. Also confirmed live: curl -X POST /mcp without the header against a running `python -m dnsfilter_mcp` -> HTTP 401

text: Given DNSFilter responds 429, when any tool is called, then the service retries with backoff honoring Retry-After, and a persisting 429 surfaces a structured rate_limited error, never a raw exception
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_rate_limit_retries_then_surfaces_rate_limited -> 1 passed; respx route always returns 429 with Retry-After:0, asserts route.call_count==4 (1 initial + 3 retries) and final body is {error:{code:rate_limited,retryable:true}}

text: Given an organization/network/policy id that DNSFilter returns 404 for, when the matching get_* tool is called, then it returns a structured not_found error, not an empty 200 or a 500
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k 'test_get_organization_not_found or test_get_network_not_found or test_get_policy_not_found' -> 3 passed; each mocks a 404 from DNSFilter and asserts {error:{code:not_found,retryable:false}}

text: Given a list_* tool whose underlying DNSFilter query matches nothing, when it is called, then it returns an empty items collection, not a not_found error
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_list_tool_empty_result_is_not_not_found -> 1 passed; mocked 200 with data:[] -> asserts body == {items:[],has_more:false}, no error key

text: Given two concurrent tool calls carrying two different X-Dnsfilter-Api-Key values, when both are in flight at once, then neither call's outbound request to DNSFilter ever carries the other call's API key
evidence: uv run pytest -v -k test_concurrent_requests_never_cross_credentials -> 1 passed; asyncio.gather runs two requests concurrently through GatewayTokenMiddleware with an explicit await asyncio.sleep(0) interleave point, asserts each request's contextvar-read key matches only its own header value

text: Given a real DNSFilter tenant and account, when dnsfilter_get_traffic_summary and dnsfilter_get_top_report are called via tools/call for a given window, then the numbers match what the DNSFilter dashboard shows for that same tenant and window
steps: Obtain a real DNSFilter trial/test account and API key (needs a real vendor account — not available at design time)
Call tools/call for dnsfilter_get_traffic_summary (metric=requests, then metric=threats) for a fixed from/to window
Call tools/call for dnsfilter_get_top_report for each dimension for the same window
Log into the DNSFilter dashboard for the same account and read the equivalent reports for the same window
expect: The counts/top-N entries returned by the tools match what the DNSFilter dashboard displays for the same account and window
reason: No real DNSFilter account available in this unattended dev run (needs a real vendor account per SOP "no test account is not a blocker" — does not block merge, dev-done, or INT publish). Field-mapping assumptions this test would confirm are documented in README Known Gaps and docs/tickets/PRD-21229.md Risks & dependencies.
